qa_pairs.question: What is the Metrix portal URL for the Nibi cluster?
qa_pairs.answer: The Metrix portal URL for the Nibi cluster is `https://portal.nibi.sharcnet.ca`.

qa_pairs.question: What role does Nibi play within the Metrix portal system for Alliance users?
qa_pairs.answer: Nibi is one of the Alliance clusters for which the Metrix portal provides interactive, real-time resource usage data (CPU, GPU, memory, file system) for users, accessible via its dedicated portal at `https://portal.nibi.sharcnet.ca`.
